label: The plane that matches the surface
section: The plane that matches the surface

visual.title: Two slopes make one plane
visual.caption: The shaded patch touches the surface at the probe. Its two slopes are the partial derivatives, so the plane matches the surface value and both directional slopes there.

predict.question: What supplies the coefficients of the tangent plane?
predict.explain: z = f(x0, y0) + fx (x − x0) + fy (y − y0). The two slopes are the partial derivatives at the probe.
